summary.text: Lily V. Franklin is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 41st District, which covers part of Montgomery County and part of Roanoke County, and has served since January 14, 2026.
Franklin sits on the House committees on Communications, Technology and Innovation; Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources; and General Laws.

paragraphs.text: Lily V. Franklin was born in Roanoke, VA, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Franklin's education as Northside High School (2012) and Longwood University (B.A., Political Science, 2015).
The profile gives Franklin's occupation as small business owner, substitute teacher.
